Meta.title: REZERVOLT — Turnkey Solar Power Systems
Meta.description: Design, installation and maintenance of solar power systems of any complexity — from residential rooftops to industrial plants. Full turnkey cycle.

Hero.subtitle: We design, install and maintain solar power systems of any complexity. From the first estimate to launch and monitoring — every stage is handled by one team.

Services.title: Every kind of work — from the simplest to the most complex

items.desc: Systems for offices, retail and production with predictable payback and monitoring.

items.title: Maintenance & monitoring

items.title: Service support

items.title: Day-ahead market operations

steps.desc: We prepare documents and arrange the feed-in tariff / net-billing and technical conditions.

steps.title: Installation
steps.desc: Our own certified crews install the system precisely and on schedule.

steps.title: Connection & launch

steps.title: Service & monitoring

solar.intro: A grid-tied plant for self-consumption. Savings are counted at your electricity tariff.

storage.intro: The battery charges from the grid in the cheapest day-ahead market (DAM) hours and powers your site in the most expensive ones.

assumptions.title: What the estimate assumes
assumptions.solarYield: Output of {value} kWh per 1 kW of capacity per year (Ukrainian average).
assumptions.solarCoverage: The plant is sized for ~{value}% of annual consumption: the summer surplus sells on the DAM for almost nothing.
assumptions.solarSelfUse: {value}% of the generated energy is used on site and counted at your tariff.
assumptions.storagePlan: For every day of the period we find the most profitable charge and discharge hours at actual DAM prices.
assumptions.storageEfficiency: Round-trip efficiency of {value}%; the battery cycles on {availability}% of days.
assumptions.storageFees: Transmission and distribution (~{fee} per kWh) cost you only on losses — battery energy isn't bought from the grid.
assumptions.storageLoad: The site's load during discharge hours is at least the battery's power.
assumptions.vat: Equipment, works and savings include {value}% VAT.

Calculator.disclaimer: A preliminary estimate: equipment prices are approximate and battery income depends on future DAM prices. We prepare the exact quote after a free audit.

items.q: How much does a solar system cost?
items.a: The cost depends on capacity, system type and equipment. After a free audit you get an exact quote and a payback calculation.
For a private house it's usually 1–3 weeks including design and approvals. Large sites run on an individual schedule.

items.q: Does the system work during power outages?
items.a: Yes, if it's a hybrid system with storage or backup power. We'll pick a solution that fits your needs.
Up to 25 years on panels, separate warranties for inverters and installation, plus a plant performance guarantee.

items.q: Do you help with paperwork and financing?
items.a: Yes. We handle approvals and technical conditions and help with installments, loans and support programs.
